title: Master Trainer OpenAI (AI & Cloud Partners), London
description:
Your mission

You train the technical teams of strategic cloud partners to build, integrate and support AI applications with confidence. Your audience is solution architects, field engineers, developers, technical consultants and sales engineering teams.

You take a proven AI curriculum and make it work for cloud partner audiences: real deployment scenarios, partner-specific examples, live troubleshooting. You are the technical face of our client in the room.


Your tasks include:

  • Deliver instructor-led bootcamps, technical workshops, train-the-trainer sessions and hands-on labs for cloud partner organisations.
  • Adapt core AI training content for partner audiences such as solution architects, field engineers, developers and partner enablement leaders.
  • Translate AI capabilities into practical cloud scenarios, reference architectures and customer-facing use cases.
  • Lead practical exercises on how to build, integrate, deploy, evaluate and support AI applications in cloud environments.
  • Troubleshoot participant issues live, from lab setup and API calls to code samples and implementation questions.
  • Work with program leadership and partner enablement stakeholders to refine delivery plans and localise examples.
  • Keep delivery quality high across regions, cohorts and groups with different technical maturity.
  • Capture recurring knowledge gaps and recommend improvements to content, labs and facilitation guides.


Your profile

You move comfortably between developer-level detail, cloud architecture context and an executive-friendly explanation. You are energised by teaching complex material and you earn credibility with engineers by knowing your stuff.


Experience & Education

  • More than 5 years of professional experience in technical training, developer education, solution architecture, technical consulting, partner engineering, software development or cloud enablement.
  • Experience delivering technical workshops, bootcamps, labs or train-the-trainer sessions for professional audiences.
  • Strong practical fluency with generative AI, LLM concepts, prompt engineering, APIs, SDKs and modern AI application patterns.
  • Hands-on familiarity with cloud platforms and partner environments such as AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure or Oracle Cloud.
  • Fluent English; a second language (French, Spanish or German) is a strong plus.
  • Located in or near a major EMEA city with an airport (for example London).
  • Willingness to travel for partner workshops and regional programs (approx. 25-35%).
  • Of advantage: familiarity with Amazon Bedrock (AWS Bedrock).
  • Of advantage: experience enabling cloud partners, hyperscalers, systems integrators or partner field organisations.
  • Of advantage: experience building hands-on labs, certification pathways or partner academies.

Skills & Attributes

  • Explains cloud and AI concepts clearly to engineers, architects and business stakeholders alike.
  • Facilitates live technical labs and solves setup, code and API issues on the spot.
  • Strong executive presence and professional conduct with senior partner stakeholders.
  • Adapts content and communication style to different proficiency levels, regions and roles.
  • Reads, explains and lightly modifies sample code in Python or JavaScript.
  • Understands RAG, vector search, AI agents and workflow orchestration well enough to teach them.
  • Of advantage: experience with developer relations, sales engineering enablement or solution architect training.


Why us?

You teach AI to the people who bring it to enterprise customers, with a premium learner experience as the standard.

Impact: Your sessions build the technical confidence that drives AI adoption across partner field teams in EMEA.

Responsibility: You own the delivery quality of your workshops and represent a leading AI company directly with strategic partners.

Dynamics: AI products change fast, and so does your content; you work in a small team that decides quickly.

Development: Product training and credentialing are provided, and you grow into a specialist role in a new, high-visibility training program.


Benefits

  • Home office possibility
  • Flexible working hours
  • Subsidised Gym Membership
  • Apple hardware (laptop & iPhone)


These are the recruiting steps that await you:

  1. Culture Fit - Get to know Rike or Kim from our People team. Learn more about nonplusultra and our culture.
  2. Content & Role Fit Interview - Go deeper into the role with Matze Schulz and a technical colleague from OpenAI.
  3. Case Study - Work through a practical training scenario together with Matze Schulz and a technical colleague from OpenAI.

title: Customer Care Specialist
description:
Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

 

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here.

 

The role

Health is complex, personal, and deeply important to our members. As the voice of Lucis clients, you support them throughout their health journey and own member happiness end to end.

With rapid member growth, we are hiring our first dedicated Customer Care Team Lead. You will own the member experience end-to-end, stabilize our operational metrics, and build and manage a world-class support team.

What you will own

  • Member support: Resolve member and lab partner inquiries via chat, email and phone, with warmth, precision and a sense of urgency.

  • Phone-first when it matters: Pick up the phone whenever a situation calls for a human voice: a delayed result, a stressful moment, a confused member.

  • Know your boundaries: Work hand in hand with our medical team and know exactly when to escalate a health question rather than answer it yourself.

  • Voice of the member: Spot recurring issues and turn them into clear, structured feedback for the product and ops teams.

  • Contribute to projects: Take part in initiatives that improve the member experience, like rebuilding our Help Center, designing proactive care for lab delays, or automating repetitive workflows with AI.

 

About you

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

 

You’ll fit in well if

  • Experience: 1+ years in B2C customer care, support, hospitality, or any role where you dealt directly with customers. Strong recent graduates with relevant experience are welcome too.

  • Bilingual: Fluent in both English and French, written and spoken.

  • People-first energy: You bring genuine warmth and empathy to every interaction, and you turn routine support into memorable experiences.

  • Rigorous precision: Exceptional attention to detail, with zero tolerance for misquotes, wrong information or operational errors. In health, accuracy is care.

  • Builder mindset: When something breaks twice, your instinct is to fix the root cause, not just the ticket.

Nice to have

  • Support tooling: You've used Intercom or similar support tools.

  • AI automation: You've already used AI tools to automate part of your work.

  • Startup mindset: You thrive in early-stage environments with high autonomy, rapid execution and clear communication.

 

The process

  • Intro call, culture & role fit (20 min)

  • Case study interview (30-60 min)

  • Deep dive and team chat, on-site (2 hours)

  • Reference calls

How we work

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. We’re open to relocation support for the right individuals, and we welcome missionaries who travel to work with us in Paris on a regular basis.

  • Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.

  • Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.

  • Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.

title: Icarus Digital Marketing: Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer
description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. The work You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. • Decide what each batch should test and why. • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. What you must be good at • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish • Fast, organised batch production • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test You are probably not right for this role if • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context. • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism. • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work. • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision. • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production. • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples. • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback. What success looks like Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow. Compensation The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000 . If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month , based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator. We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output. How to apply Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work. • Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed. • For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel. • Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable. • Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed. • List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset. • Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. • State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial. title: Anti-Corruption & Trade Compliance Legal Counsel
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary

We are looking for an Anti-Corruption & Trade Compliance Legal Counsel to play a central role in the building, development and operation of Mistral AI's corporate compliance framework, with a particular focus on anti-corruption, economic sanctions and export controls.

Reporting to the Lead Anti-Corruption & Trade Compliance, the position offers genuine build-from-scratch ownership of core policies, processes and tools. It combines programme development, day-to-day compliance operations and cross-functional advisory work.

The role involves close collaboration with Legal, Finance, Procurement, Sales, Security, and Product and Engineering to translate legal requirements into clear, proportionate and auditable processes.

Key responsibilities

Anti-corruption/Sapin II

  • Coordinate Sapin II Action Plan deployment of relevant policies, controls, training and third-party procedure.

  • Lead the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of risk-based due diligence from integrity screening through enhanced diligence and periodic review;

  • Support the implementation and periodic review of the code of conduct, related policies, whistleblowing framework and training programme,

  • Administer the gifts, hospitality and conflicts-of-interest processes, including reviewing requests and declarations, maintaining the relevant records and registers, and providing practical guidance to business teams.

  • Work with Finance and Internal Control to define and monitor risk-based anti-corruption accounting controls.

  • Contribute to the monitoring and periodic assessment of the anti-corruption programme, including programme records, metrics and reporting; monitor relevant regulatory and enforcement developments; and support anti-corruption incidents, internal reviews and investigations.

Economic sanctions and export controls

  • Manage screening for new and existing counterparties as part of third-party due diligence and transaction-review processes.

  • Support the Lead Anti-Corruption and Trade Compliance in export control classification of AI models, software, technology, compute infrastructure and hardware.

  • Work with Procurement, Operations, Product and Engineering to embed screening and access-control requirements into onboarding, contracting and deployment processes, and maintain clear, auditable records and internal guidance.

  • Develop and maintain standard sanctions and export-control contractual positions and clauses, and support their review and negotiation in customer, supplier, partner and reseller agreements.

  • Monitor relevant regulatory and enforcement developments; coordinate external counsel and advisers; contribute to programme reporting for Legal leadership.

Qualifications and skills

  • Legal Master degree (Master’s in Business Law, Corporate Law, Compliance, or equivalent). Compliance certifications are also an asset.

  • A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in a company, law firm, consulting firm or regulatory authority.

  • Substantive exposure to at least two of the following areas: anti-corruption and Sapin II, economic sanctions, and export controls.

  • Experience in the technology or AI sector is a plus (understanding of data, semiconductors, or dual-use goods), as well as knowledge and understanding of artificial intelligence.

  • Analytical and problem solving skills: Candidates should be able to analyze complex topics and have strong problem-solving skills, and be able to dig into internal systems.

How we work

  • Velocity. Optimize for rate of learning. Take action, get feedback, get better.

As a Sales Ops Analyst, you’ll be a foundational operational partner to our EMEA sales and customer success teams.
